text: Kanchan Maharaj, Senior Engineer, Cycling and Pedestrian Projects and Igor Samardzic, Project Lead, Cycling and Pedestrian Projects, Transportation Services will make a presentation, which focuses on the achievements and goals in cycling, sidewalks, and accessibility within the Cycling and Pedestrian Projects unit. It details the expansion of cycling and pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks and bikeways, with an emphasis on improving accessibility, safety, and comfort for seniors, people with disabilities, and other vulnerable road users. Additionally, the presentation outlines specific accomplishments from 2023 and sets goals for 2024 to further enhance sidewalk delivery and accessibility.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
